brief:
The father of an Israeli man killed by Israeli military fire during the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attack has called Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a "traitor," Middle East Eye reported. The incident occurred as Israeli forces responded to the initial assault that killed hundreds of Israelis.

The statement reflects growing criticism from Israeli families affected by the conflict, including those who lost relatives to Israeli military action during the chaotic opening hours of the war.
